items.title: Classify the five proof admissibility convergence gaps
items.context: Confirm which gaps are annotation-only versus missing implementation before changing code. The five gaps are supportedSchemaVersion, verifierVersionSupported, contractVersionSupported, unsupported_schema_version, and unsupported_contract_version.
items.userSees: User sees: "5 high proof-admissibility gaps classified: 4 mapping gaps, 1 verifierVersionSupported semantic gap."

happy.desc: The five current high gaps are classified with evidence from code and gap_analyze output.

edge.desc: The unrelated medium currentDoneMaterialBinding gap is explicitly kept out of scope.

adversarial.desc: The story does not classify server receipt demotion or Red/Repro gate work as part of these five gaps.

verificationEvidence.note: Red/Repro classification confirmed: before implementation gap_analyze reported exactly the five targeted high proof-admissibility gaps; after implementation the same command reports 0 high / 1 unrelated medium.
The only remaining gap is medium currentDoneMaterialBinding missing @test, explicitly outside B-fbfb scope.
Scope contract excludes server production receipt demotion/deletion and Red/Repro/Spike gate implementation; B-fbfb code diff touches only proof-admissibility core/gates/smokes.
